title: diphryllum australe
intro: Diphryllum australe, commonly known as the Australian forked club moss, is a type of plant species in the family Selaginellaceae. It is known for its forked branches and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of Diphryllum australe include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential health benefits.
